pairs.target: shuǐcáo biān de shítou hái liáng , xià róng yǐjīng dào le . tā bǎ biǎn pídài huànchéng yìzhī bèi gāo de zhúlǒu , jíjiàn yòng yóubù guǒ zài zuì shàngmiàn , xiàmiàn sāi zhe liǎng xiǎobāo tì shúrén shāo de zhēn .
pairs.english: The stones beside the water trough were still cool, but Xiarong had arrived. She had exchanged her flat leather bag for a tall-backed bamboo basket, the urgent packet wrapped in oilcloth on top and two little packets of needles for acquaintances tucked below.
pairs.hanzi: 水槽边的石头还凉，夏绒已经到了。她把扁皮袋换成一只背高的竹篓，急件用油布裹在最上面，下面塞着两小包替熟人捎的针。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi gǎndào shí , tā gāng xìjǐn xiédài , jiàn tā bèizhe shuǐhú , biàn shuō jīnrì zǒngsuàn búyòng tā tì shuí zhǎo yìgēn shéng .
pairs.english: When Tavi arrived, she had just tied her shoes. Seeing his flask on his back, she said at least today she would not have to find anyone a cord.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维赶到时，她刚系紧鞋带，见他背着水壶，便说今日总算不用她替谁找一根绳。

pairs.target: tāmen yán réng kāifàng de dàlù wǎngxiàzǒu , guò le bǔ gōu chàkǒu , shānpō jiànjiàn jiāng huòchǎng dǎng zài hòumiàn .
pairs.english: They followed the still-open main road downward. Past the ditch-repair junction, the slope gradually hid the freight yard behind them.
pairs.hanzi: 他们沿仍开放的大路往下走，过了补沟岔口，山坡渐渐将货场挡在后面。

pairs.target: xià róng zǒu dé wěn , bù gǎn tā , yùjiàn yùn kōng kuāng shànglái de rén hái tíng le liǎngbù , bǎ yìzhī cāshāng de shǒuzhǎng kànguò , gàosù duìfāng xiàbiān pùzi gāngshāo le rèshuǐ , bié ná gōu shuǐxǐ .
pairs.english: Xiarong walked steadily without hurrying him. Meeting someone bringing empty baskets up, she paused to look at a scraped palm and said the shop below had just heated water: don't wash with ditch water.
pairs.hanzi: 夏绒走得稳，不赶他，遇见运空筐上来的人还停了两步，把一只擦伤的手掌看过，告诉对方下边铺子刚烧了热水，别拿沟水洗。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi běnlái xiǎng zhǎo tú shàng nàge cháowài tū de shí zuǐ , zhuǎnguò wān cái fāxiàn , shí zuǐ cóng shàngmiàn kàn xiàng yīng tóu , cóng lùshang kàn què zhǐshì yídào dīǎi de shíqiáng .
pairs.english: Tavi had meant to find the jutting rock on the map. Only around the bend did he realize that, from above it looked like an eagle's head, but from the road it was merely a low stone wall.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维本来想找图上那个朝外凸的石嘴，转过弯才发现，石嘴从上面看像鹰头，从路上看却只是一道低矮的石墙。

pairs.target: tú méiyǒu huà cuò , tā kàn de dìfāng biàn le . xià róng děng tā rènchū xià yíduànlù , cái shēnshǒu cóng lǒu biān qǔ bǐng , yíbàn yǎo zhe , lìngyíbàn wèn tā yào buyào .
pairs.english: The map was not wrong; his viewpoint had changed. Xiarong waited for him to identify the next stretch before taking flatbread from her basket, biting one half and offering him the other.
pairs.hanzi: 图没有画错，他看的地方变了。夏绒等他认出下一段路，才伸手从篓边取饼，一半咬着，另一半问他要不要。

pairs.target: tā qǔchū zìjǐ nà kuài , gěi tā kàn le yìyǎn . tā xiào , shuō bié ná dé xiàng jiè xìng kǎohé , bǐng yòu búyòng pèichéng yíyàng dà .
pairs.english: He took out his own piece to show her. She laughed: don't hold it like a borrowing assessment; the breads don't have to be matched in size.
pairs.hanzi: 他取出自己那块，给她看了一眼。她笑，说别拿得像借性考核，饼又不用配成一样大。

pairs.target: tā yě xiào , bǎ bǐng sāi huí wàiyī , xiān hē le yìkǒu shuǐ .
pairs.english: He laughed too, put the bread back in his coat and drank some water first.
pairs.hanzi: 他也笑，把饼塞回外衣，先喝了一口水。

pairs.target: tái jǐng de wūdǐng zài shānwō lǐ jù chéng yìtuán , zuìxiān kànjiàn de quèshì shài zài wūdǐng de hóngbù .
pairs.english: Moss Well's roofs clustered in a hollow, but the first thing visible was red cloth drying on the rooftops.
pairs.hanzi: 苔井的屋顶在山窝里聚成一团，最先看见的却是晒在屋顶的红布。

pairs.target: lù bǐ zhènzǐ gāo , cóng shàngmiàn wàng guòqù , yǒu gè nǚrén xiàng zhàn zài yípiàn ànhóng de shuǐshàng , wānyāo jiāng bù jiǎo yèjìn jiāzi lǐ .
pairs.english: The road stood above the town. From there, a woman seemed to stand on dark red water, bending to tuck a corner of cloth into a clip.
pairs.hanzi: 路比镇子高，从上面望过去，有个女人像站在一片暗红的水上，弯腰将布角掖进夹子里。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi tíngxiàlái duō kàn le yìyǎn , bíjiān wéndào yǔ fēng zhàn bùtóng de wèidào , shī tǔ lǐ yǒu gǔ tián qì , lùpáng jǐkē shù kāi zhe xìbái de huā .
pairs.english: Tavi stopped for another look, smelling something different from Wind Trestle: sweetness in the wet soil, with delicate white blossoms on several roadside trees.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维停下来多看了一眼，鼻尖闻到与风栈不同的味道，湿土里有股甜气，路旁几棵树开着细白的花。

pairs.target: zhèn kǒu zhēn yǒu yìkǒu jǐng , jǐngyán cháng zhe tái , pángbiān lìng yǒu yídào yǐnshuǐ cáo .
pairs.english: There really was a well at the town entrance, moss growing on its rim and a separate water channel beside it.
pairs.hanzi: 镇口真有一口井，井沿长着苔，旁边另有一道引水槽。

pairs.target: háizi men wéizhe qiǎn cáo fàng yèpiàn chuán , yígè xiǎo de jiāng chuán fàng fǎn , shuǐ cóng chuánwěi guànjìnqù , pángbiān de rén jiào dé bǐ sòng huòxiāng shí hái jí .
pairs.english: Children floated leaf boats around the shallow channel. A little one put his boat in backward and water poured in through its stern; the others shouted more urgently than during a freight arrival.
pairs.hanzi: 孩子们围着浅槽放叶片船，一个小的将船放反，水从船尾灌进去，旁边的人叫得比送货厢时还急。

pairs.target: xià róng yòng jiǎojiān ràngkāi shuǐbiān de shízǐ , méi tì tāmen bǎ chuán lāoqǐ .
pairs.english: Xiarong nudged a waterside stone aside with her toe but did not fish out the boat for them.
pairs.hanzi: 夏绒用脚尖让开水边的石子，没替他们把船捞起。

pairs.target: tā yào sòng de bāoguǒ zài mùliào pù jiāojiē . zhǎngguì dǎkāi yóubù , shù de shì jǐzhāng gǎnzhe bǔ sòng de chǐcùn tú , búshì guìzhòng de bǎobèi .
pairs.english: She handed over her parcel at a timber shop. The shopkeeper opened the oilcloth and counted several urgently supplied replacement dimension drawings, not precious treasures.
pairs.hanzi: 她要送的包裹在木料铺交接。掌柜打开油布，数的是几张赶着补送的尺寸图，不是贵重的宝贝。

pairs.target: kě yìzhāng tú chí yírì , zhuāng chuāng de rén biàn yào duō děng yírì , tā xiè guò xià róng , jiāng shōutiáo hé qián yìtóng dìguòlái , tā dāngchǎng shù qīng , jì zài zìjǐ nà běn biānjiǎo móyuán de xiǎocè shàng .
pairs.english: But a drawing one day late meant a window fitter waiting one extra day. He thanked Xiarong and handed her receipt and payment together; she counted it on the spot and recorded it in her little booklet with worn rounded corners.
pairs.hanzi: 可一张图迟一日，装窗的人便要多等一日，他谢过夏绒，将收条和钱一同递过来，她当场数清，记在自己那本边角磨圆的小册上。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zài ménwài děng , wàngjiàn pù qiángshàng guà zhe yìzhǎn biǎnbiǎnde dēng . dēng shēn yǒu céng báopiàn hù zhe , dǐxià jiā le yígè néng lái huízhuǎn de xiǎo huán , hé tā jiàn guò de tídēng bù yíyàng .
pairs.english: Waiting outside, Tavi saw a flat lamp hanging on the shop wall. Thin panels protected its body, with a little swinging ring added underneath, unlike lanterns he had seen.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维在门外等，望见铺墙上挂着一盏扁扁的灯。灯身有层薄片护着，底下加了一个能来回转的小环，和他见过的提灯不一样。

pairs.target: zhǎngguì tīngjiàn tā wèn , shuō shì dōngmiàn dàhé chuánshàng yòng de , làng guòlái shí dēng wǎn néng mànxiē wāi , lǐtou zhàoyàng yòngyóu , méiyǒu cáng zhe xuégōng de běnshì .
pairs.english: Hearing his question, the shopkeeper said it was used on boats on the great river to the east; when waves came, the lamp bowl tilted more slowly. It still used oil inside, with no hidden academy skill.
pairs.hanzi: 掌柜听见他问，说是东面大河船上用的，浪过来时灯碗能慢些歪，里头照样用油，没有藏着学宫的本事。

pairs.target: " chuánshàng yě yào zhèzhǒng chuāngkuàng ? " tā zhǐ le zhǐ mén lǐ de huò . " yào , chǐcùn bùtóng . zǒng bùnéng xià le shān , jiù dōu bú shuì wūlǐ le . "
pairs.english: “Boats need window frames like these too?” He pointed at the stock inside. “Yes, different dimensions. People don't all stop sleeping in rooms once they come down from the mountains.”
pairs.hanzi:
“船上也要这种窗框？”他指了指门里的货。
“要，尺寸不同。总不能下了山，就都不睡屋里了。”

pairs.target: zhǎngguì shuōwán , zhuǎntóu qù zhāohū tái mùtou de rén , liúxià tā zhàn zài dēng xià xiào zìjǐ de wèn fǎ .
pairs.english: The shopkeeper turned to attend to people carrying timber, leaving him beneath the lamp laughing at how he had asked.
pairs.hanzi: 掌柜说完，转头去招呼抬木头的人，留下他站在灯下笑自己的问法。

pairs.target: xià róng shōu hǎo cèzǐ chūlái , jiàn tā hái kàn , wèn shìbushì yào bānhuíqù . tā yáotóu , yòu wèn tā zuìyuǎn sòngdào nǎlǐ .
pairs.english: Xiarong came out after putting away her booklet; seeing him still looking, she asked if he wanted to take it home. He shook his head and asked the farthest place she had delivered to.
pairs.hanzi: 夏绒收好册子出来，见他还看，问是不是要搬回去。他摇头，又问她最远送到哪里。

pairs.target: tā shuō nánmiàn de bái péng yì , yào zài wàitou zhù yíyè , qùguò sì huí , hái méi líkāi zhū bāng liè zhe de gōnglù .
pairs.english: She said White Awning Station to the south, requiring one night away. She had been four times and had never left the public roads listed by the mountain states.
pairs.hanzi: 她说南面的白棚驿，要在外头住一夜，去过四回，还没离开诸邦列着的公路。

pairs.target: tā yǐwéi zhèhuà lǐ yǒu yìdiǎn yíhàn , biàn shuō yǐhòu huì zǒu dé gèng yuǎn . tā què tíng le yíxià , gàosù tā zìjǐ xiān xiǎng zǎn chū yìtiáo gùdìng de dì jiàn xiàn , búyòng nǎjiā línshí hǎnyìshēng biàn wǎng nǎ pǎo .
pairs.english: Thinking there was a little regret in that, he said she would go farther in future. But she paused and told him she first wanted to save up for a regular delivery route, instead of running wherever a firm called at short notice.
pairs.hanzi: 他以为这话里有一点遗憾，便说以后会走得更远。她却停了一下，告诉他自己先想攒出一条固定的递件线，不用哪家临时喊一声便往哪跑。

pairs.target: yuǎn buyuǎn yǐhòu zàishuō , xiān yào rénjiā rènde tā dì de shì shénme , búshì zhī rènde tā pǎodékuài .
pairs.english: Distance could wait; first she wanted people to know what she delivered, rather than only knowing she ran fast.
pairs.hanzi: 远不远以后再说，先要人家认得她递的是什么，不是只认得她跑得快。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi mōlemō yīdài lǐ de tú , méiyǒu jiē yíjù zìjǐ yě yíyàng . tā cáigāng xué zhe rèn zìjǐ de lù , tā yǐjīng zài yìtiáo láihuí de lùshang xiǎng le hǎojǐnián .
pairs.english: Tavi touched the map in his pocket without adding that he was the same. He had only just begun finding his own way; she had been thinking about a route there and back for several years.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维摸了摸衣袋里的图，没有接一句自己也一样。他才刚学着认自己的路，她已经在一条来回的路上想了好几年。

pairs.target: liǎng rén zài pù qián zhàn zhe hēwán shuǐ , xià róng kànguò rìyǐng , tíxǐng tā méizǐ dé xiànzài mǎi , zài wǎng xià guàng , huílái biàn gǎnbúshàng fàn .
pairs.english: They finished their water standing outside the shop. Xiarong checked the sun's shadow and reminded him to buy the plums now; if they wandered farther, they would miss lunch on returning.
pairs.hanzi: 两人在铺前站着喝完水，夏绒看过日影，提醒他梅子得现在买，再往下逛，回来便赶不上饭。

pairs.target: méizǐ pù hái kāi zhe , jīnrì mài de shì yānguò shàigān de , sā le báibái yìcéng yánshuāng .
pairs.english: The plum shop was still open, selling pickled dried plums today under a white coating of salt.
pairs.hanzi: 梅子铺还开着，今日卖的是腌过晒干的，撒了白白一层盐霜。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi cháng yìkē , suān dé yǎnjiǎo dōu suōqǐlái , zhǎngguì biàn xiào zhe gěi tā tiān le bànkē tián de , wèn yào buyào zhèyàng hùn zhe bāo .
pairs.english: Tavi tried one and its sourness made his eyes scrunch up. Laughing, the shopkeeper added half a sweet one and asked if he wanted a mixed packet like that.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维尝一颗，酸得眼角都缩起来，掌柜便笑着给他添了半颗甜的，问要不要这样混着包。

pairs.target: tā mǎi le liǎng xiǎobāo , yìbāo dǎsuàn gěi wēn xiù liú zhe , lìng yìbāo chuāi jìn wàiyī .
pairs.english: He bought two little packets, intending to save one for Wenxiu and tucking the other into his coat.
pairs.hanzi: 他买了两小包，一包打算给温岫留着，另一包揣进外衣。

pairs.target: huíchéng pō gèng dǒu , huà mànmàn shǎo le . tā zài néng kànjiàn fēng zhàn gāojià de dìfāng xiējiǎo , yǎngtóuwàng jiàn zǎoshàng zhē zhe bànpiàn tiān de suǒ , rújīn xìxì yídào guà zài liǎngtuán yúnyǐng zhījiān .
pairs.english: The climb back was steeper, and conversation gradually thinned. He rested where Wind Trestle's towers were visible and looked up at the cable that had covered half the sky that morning, now a fine line between two masses of cloud shadow.
pairs.hanzi: 回程坡更陡，话慢慢少了。他在能看见风栈高架的地方歇脚，仰头望见早上遮着半片天的索，如今细细一道挂在两团云影之间。

pairs.target: xiàmiàn tiánlǐ yǒurén zhí qǐshēn , cháo gōnglù shang huīshǒu , xià róng huí le yìshēng , tǎ wéi yě gēnzhe tái le shǒu , suīrán bù zhīdào duìfāng shì shuí .
pairs.english: Someone straightened in the fields below and waved toward the road. Xiarong called back; Tavi raised his hand too, though he did not know who it was.
pairs.hanzi: 下面田里有人直起身，朝公路上挥手，夏绒回了一声，塔维也跟着抬了手，虽然不知道对方是谁。

pairs.target: wǔfàn qián tāmen huídào shuǐcáo páng . tā háiyào qù jiāo xià yìzhāng shōutiáo , zhuǎnshēn biàn zǒu .
pairs.english: They returned to the water trough before lunch. She still had another receipt to deliver and turned straight away.
pairs.hanzi: 午饭前他们回到水槽旁。她还要去交下一张收条，转身便走。

pairs.target: tā bǎ liúgěi wēn xiù de méizǐ dàihuí gōngpéng , jiàn tā bú zài , xiān fàngzài zìjǐ zhuō jiǎo , zài bāo wài xiě shàng míngzì .
pairs.english: He took Wenxiu's plums back to the workshop and, finding her out, put them on his table corner for now and wrote her name on the wrapper.
pairs.hanzi: 他把留给温岫的梅子带回工棚，见她不在，先放在自己桌角，在包外写上名字。

pairs.target: xiě wán yòu kàn le yíbiàn , méi bǎ xiàshān jiàn guò de nàzhǎn chuán dēng huà zài bāo shàng , liú zhe xiàwǔ qīnkǒushuō .
pairs.english: He looked it over again, leaving the boat lamp he had seen below off the packet so he could tell her about it in person that afternoon.
pairs.hanzi: 写完又看了一遍，没把下山见过的那盏船灯画在包上，留着下午亲口说。
